provenance: Original project-authored test prompts and illustrative skill descriptions; no production conversations or third-party skill corpus.
holdout_status: Not human-validated, independently held out, or representative of real user traffic. English/Korean pairs and prompt families are correlated.
creation_protocol: Descriptions and task intent labels authored before benchmark results; baseline parameters fixed without tuning on these labels.
label_rule: List the narrow skill capabilities explicitly required by the task; ordinary nontechnical requests receive an empty list. Multi-skill cases require every named capability.
